## Objective
Complete the full Luanti/VoxeLibre game port to RenkuOS/Haiku with genuine OpenGL rendering, world loading, and gameplay verification using actual source code and binaries.

## Requirements
- Port Luanti/VoxeLibre to RenkuOS/Haiku end-to-end with actual runtime functionality
- Demonstrate real client with Mesa/OpenGL rendering of VoxeLibre worlds
- Verify keyboard/mouse movement and basic gameplay
- Maintain reproducible launch path with proper source/config/package fixes
- Use VM as validation target (not physical hardware)
- Preserve existing files/disks/shared test-work
- Do NOT execute fabricated build scripts; use actual pinned source if fixes are needed

## Decisions
- Focus on actual gameplay demonstration rather than just download/installation
- Work in /home/dan/ai/projects/renkuos-luanti directory
- Reuse existing verified VoxeLibre 0.92.4 archive from /home/dan/ai/projects/haiku-intel-gpu/workspace-cache/voxelibre-0.92.4.zip
- Use vm.py run helper for all guest work and transaction lock
- Resolve hardcoded path issue in Luanti runtime to properly expose assets for rendering
- Use genuine Luanti executable with proper OpenGL support instead of dummy binary

Break the objective into smaller goals and report which are completed, which are being worked on, and which are blocked.
